source: The Mordheimer's Master Skill List Compilation v1.30 (compiled by Edwin "The Mordheimer" Molina, based on prior work by Tim Leach), fetched from https://www.broheim.net/downloads/resources/Master%20Skill%20List.pdf on 2026-07-03. Core lists cite the Mordheim rulebook (RB) page numbers as given in that document; owner should still cross-check against their own physical rulebook printing. Black Orc, Amazon, Lizardmen (Skink and Saurus) and Battle Monk special skill lists supplied directly by the owner on 2026-08-02.

skills.name: Strike to Injure
skills.effect: Add +1 to all injury rolls caused by the model in hand-to-hand combat. (RB 122)

skills.name: Combat Master
skills.effect: If the warrior fights against more than one enemy at a time, he gains an extra Attack in each hand-to-hand combat phase as long as he is fighting two or more enemy models. The warrior is also immune to 'All Alone' tests. (RB 122)

skills.name: Weapons Training
skills.effect: The warrior may use any hand-to-hand combat weapon he comes across, not just those in his equipment options. (RB 122)

skills.name: Web of Steel
skills.effect: The model gains +1 to all his rolls on Critical Hit tables in hand-to-hand combat. (RB 122)

skills.name: Expert Swordsman
skills.effect: The warrior may re-roll all missed attacks if using a sword in the hand-to-hand phase of the turn he charges. Only applies when armed with normal swords or weeping blades, not double-handed swords or other weapons. (RB 122)

skills.name: Step Aside
skills.effect: Each time the warrior suffers a wound in close combat he may make an additional saving throw of 5+. This save is never modified and is taken after all other armour saves. (RB 122)

skills.name: Quick Shot
skills.effect: The warrior may shoot twice per turn with a bow or crossbow (but not a crossbow pistol). (RB 122 — Official Errata 2002)

skills.name: Pistolier
skills.effect: If equipped with a brace of pistols of any type (including crossbow pistols), the warrior may fire twice in the Shooting phase (normal reloading rules apply). With a single pistol he may fire it the same turn it was reloaded. (RB 122 — Official Errata 2002)

skills.name: Eagle Eyes
skills.effect: The warrior adds +6" to the range of any missile weapon he is using. (RB 122)

skills.name: Weapons Expert
skills.effect: The warrior may use any missile weapon he comes across, not just the weapons available from his warband's list. (RB 122, implied — page reference not explicit in source)

skills.name: Nimble
skills.effect: The warrior may move and fire with weapons that are normally only used if the firer has not moved. Cannot be combined with Quick Shot. (RB 122)

skills.name: Trick Shooter
skills.effect: The warrior ignores all modifiers for cover when using missile weapons. (RB 122) Suggested Changes: not usable with Quick Shot.

skills.name: Hunter
skills.effect: The warrior may fire each turn with a handgun or Hochland long rifle. (RB 122) Suggested Changes: may be used with Pistolier.

skills.name: Knife-Fighter
skills.effect: The warrior can throw a maximum of three throwing knives/throwing stars in his shooting phase and may divide his shots between any targets within range. Cannot be combined with Quick Shot. (RB 122)

skills.name: Battle Tongue
skills.effect: Leader only. Increases the range of his Leader ability by 6". Undead leaders may not use this skill. (RB 123)

prerequisite.text: Leader only. Undead leaders may not use this skill.

skills.name: Sorcery
skills.effect: Heroes capable of casting spells only. +1 to rolls to see whether a spell is cast successfully. Sisters of Sigmar and Warrior-Priests may not use this skill. (RB 123)

prerequisite.text: Heroes capable of casting spells only.

skills.name: Streetwise
skills.effect: +2 to the roll that determines chances of finding Rare items (see Trading section). (RB 123)

skills.name: Haggle
skills.effect: Deduct 2D6 gold crowns from the price of any single item (minimum cost 1gc) once per post-battle sequence. (RB 123)

skills.name: Arcane Lore
skills.effect: Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar and Warrior-Priests may not have this skill. A warrior with this skill may learn Lesser Magic if he owns a Tome of Magic. (RB 123)

prerequisite.text: Witch Hunters, Sisters of Sigmar and Warrior-Priests may not have this skill.

skills.name: Wyrdstone Hunter
skills.effect: If a Hero with this skill searches ruins in the exploration phase, re-roll one dice when rolling on the Exploration chart; the second result stands. (RB 123)

skills.name: Warrior Wizard
skills.effect: Spellcasters only. Allows the wizard to wear armour and cast spells. (RB 123)

skills.name: Scribe
skills.effect: Any warrior able to cast spells or use prayers may take this. Allows making a scroll before battle inscribed with one known spell/prayer, usable just before casting it for +2 to the difficulty roll; the scroll crumbles after use and cannot be saved between battles. (TC7)

prerequisite.text: Any warrior able to cast spells or use prayers.

skills.name: Mind Focus
skills.effect: Spellcasters/prayer users only. May re-roll one dice roll used in the difficulty roll when using a spell or prayer. (TC7)

skills.name: Tactician
skills.effect: Warband leader only. May reposition his warriors after the opponent has set up, and may advance them up to 12" onto the board instead of 8". (TC7)

skills.name: Hunch
skills.effect: Warband leader only. May position up to 3 of his XP-earning men in any ruined building on the board at least 12" from an enemy model and not in the enemy deployment zone. (TC7)

skills.name: Magical Aptitude
skills.effect: Spellcasters only (not Sisters of Sigmar or Warrior Priests). May attempt to cast two spells per turn if not in hand-to-hand combat; after the first, take a Toughness test — pass to attempt a second (even the same spell); fail and roll on the injury table immediately with no saves, treating out of action as stunned. (TC7)

skills.name: Drive Chariot
skills.effect: Required to drive a chariot effectively in combat; a charioteer without this skill cannot charge. (TC18)

skills.name: Mighty Blow
skills.effect: +1 Strength bonus in close combat (excluding pistols), applying to all close combat weapons. (RB 123)

skills.name: Pit Fighter
skills.effect: +1 WS and +1 Attacks when fighting inside buildings or ruins. Agree with your opponent what counts as 'buildings or ruins' before the battle. (RB 123)

skills.name: Resilient
skills.effect: Deduct -1 Strength from all hits against the warrior in close combat. Does not affect armour save modifiers. (RB 123)

skills.name: Fearsome
skills.effect: The model causes fear in opposing models. (RB 123)

skills.name: Strongman
skills.effect: The warrior may use a double-handed weapon without the usual penalty of always striking last. (RB 123)

skills.name: Unstoppable Charge
skills.effect: +1 to Weapon Skill when charging. (RB 123)

skills.name: Leap
skills.effect: May leap D6" in the movement phase in addition to normal movement (once per turn); may jump over man-sized models/obstacles up to 1" high without penalty, or leap gaps (committing to the leap before rolling). (RB 123)

skills.name: Sprint
skills.effect: Triples Movement rate when running or charging, instead of doubling. (RB 123)

skills.name: Acrobat
skills.effect: May fall/jump from up to 12" without damage on a passed Initiative test, and may re-roll failed Diving Charge rolls (still limited to a 6" diving charge). (RB 123)

skills.name: Lightning Reflexes
skills.effect: If charged, 'strikes first' against the charger(s); order between multiple 'strike first' combatants is resolved by comparing Initiative. (RB 123)

skills.name: Jump Up
skills.effect: May ignore Knocked Down results when rolling for injuries, unless knocked down via a successful helmet save or the No Pain special rule. (RB 123)

skills.name: Dodge
skills.effect: May avoid a missile hit on a D6 roll of 5+, rolled as soon as the hit is scored, before rolling to wound and before other skill/equipment effects. (RB 123)

skills.name: Scale Sheer Surfaces
skills.effect: May climb up/down a height equal to twice normal Movement without Initiative tests. (RB 123)

ogreSpecial.name: Ogres Special Skills (Border Town Burning — Maneaters)

skills.name: Master of Arms
skills.effect: The Ogre may wield a Difficult to Use weapon and a hand weapon at the same time, but not two Difficult to Use weapons.

skills.name: Crude Belch
skills.effect: A Hero with this may unleash thunderous fumes on all enemies engaged in close combat; those who fail a Ld test suffer -1 to hit for the turn. Must wait for a new enemy to engage before using again.

skills.name: Maneater
skills.effect: May immediately learn one skill from the Shooting or Academic skill list. May be taken only once and may not be taken by the Guide.

skills.name: Bull Charge
skills.effect: When charging, may attempt a single attack at +1 to hit instead of normal attacks; on a hit the enemy is automatically knocked down.

skills.name: Dog of War
skills.effect: The warband may hire Hired Swords available to Mercenaries. Only the leader may take this skill; if he dies, all Hired Swords are removed from the warband.

prerequisite.text: Only the leader may take this skill.

skills.name: Bellowing Roar
skills.effect: Warband leader only. Allows a re-roll of the first failed Rout test.

ogreSpecialAzmodan.name: Ogres' Special Skills (Azmodan variant)
ogreSpecialAzmodan.maintainerNote: Unofficial Azmodan Ogre warband list — NOT the Border Town Burning Maneaters list; kept for reference only, do not merge with ogreSpecial.

skills.name: Been There, Learned That
skills.effect: May only be taken once. Immediately take ONE skill from the Shooting or Academic skill list (treat Pistolier as 'handguneer'). (New — by Azmodan)

skills.name: Battle Cry
skills.effect: All enemies within 8" must take a fear test as if charged by a fear-causing opponent; on a failure they only hit (combat or shooting) on a 6 next turn. One Ogre may have this skill at a time, usable once per battle; fear-immune enemies don't test. (New — by Azmodan)

skills.name: Determined
skills.effect: Leader only. The warband may re-roll their first failed Rout test, unless the leader is out of action. (New — by Azmodan)

skills.name: Bull's Charge
skills.effect: Requires a belly plate. When charging more than 6", may use this instead of normal attacks: one attack at +1 to hit; on a hit the target is knocked down, then wounded at the Ogre's S — a wound result also stuns. Resolved before other attacks. (New — by Azmodan)

skills.name: Combat Training
skills.effect: Runt only. Allows choosing Combat skills from now on. (New — by Azmodan)

skills.name: Hardened Stomach
skills.effect: Butcher only. Count only every second spell cast for the purpose of the Indigestion table after the game. (New — by Azmodan)

skills.name: Wyrdstone Eater
skills.effect: Butcher only. May cast the seventh Lore of Gastromancy spell by consuming a Wyrdstone shard from his equipment (capturable if he goes out of action, as in the Wyrdstone Hunt scenario); doubles the spell's range and rolls 3D6 picking the two highest, but a misfire adds another die to the indigestion pool. (New — by Azmodan)

skills.name: Silent Strike
skills.effect: Roll a D6; on a 5+ the character may charge out of hiding, attack, and (if uninjured) return to his original hiding place, provided the round trip does not exceed his maximum movement (2xM, or 3xM with Sprint). On a failed roll it is treated as a normal charge. (New — by Archeonicus)

skills.name: Ultimate Kill
skills.effect: Requires 2+ Attacks. Forgo all extra HtH attacks for one attack at +1 to hit, +1 to wound, +1 on the injury roll. Not combinable with Ultimate Specialist or Strike to Injure; does not work with black powder weapons. (New — by Archeonicus)

skills.name: Master of Poisons
skills.effect: If the hero does not search for rare items, he may brew 3D-1 portions of dark venom or black lotus (single-weapon sized, must be used next battle). (New — by Archeonicus)

skills.name: Shadow Defense
skills.effect: May parry, with re-roll, with any weapon used; if the weapon already has Parry, may parry on an equal-or-higher roll, also re-rollable. (New — by Archeonicus)

skills.name: Ultimate Specialist
skills.effect: +1 WS and +1 on the injury roll. Not combinable with Ultimate Kill or Strike to Injure. (New — by Archeonicus)

skills.name: Play Dead
skills.effect: May re-roll a result on the Serious Injury table. A Shadowblade with this skill may use Vanish Into the Shadows while Stunned, or return to hiding via Silent Strike if Knocked Down. (New — by Archeonicus)

skills.name: Shaggy Hide
skills.effect: Gains a 6+ Armour Save, combinable with other armour as normal. (EiF 74)

skills.name: Mutant
skills.effect: May buy one mutation. (EiF 74)

skills.name: Fearless
skills.effect: Immune to Fear and All Alone tests. (EiF 74)

skills.name: Horned One
skills.effect: May make an additional Attack at basic Strength on a turn it charges. (EiF 74)

skills.name: Bellowing Roar
skills.effect: Beastman Chief only. May re-roll any failed Rout tests. (EiF 74)

skills.name: Manhater
skills.effect: Affected by the rules of Hatred when fighting any Human warbands. (EiF 74)

skills.name: Virtue of Purity
skills.effect: Any spell cast against the Knight is dispelled on a D6 roll of 4+. (TC8)

skills.name: Virtue of Valor
skills.effect: May re-roll missed to-hit rolls against an enemy with higher Strength. (TC8)

skills.name: Virtue of Discipline
skills.effect: Once per game, if not Out of Action, Stunned or Knocked Down, may re-roll a failed Rout Test. (TC8)

skills.name: Virtue of Noble Disdain
skills.effect: Subject to Hatred of all enemies armed with shooting weapons. (TC8)

skills.name: Virtue of the Impetuous
skills.effect: Gains an additional +D3" to move when charging, rolled each time before moving. (TC8)

skills.name: Fury of Khaine
skills.effect: May make a 4" follow-up move after taking all opponents in a combat out of action, starting a new combat (counts as charging) the following turn if it makes contact. May not follow up in the opponent's turn. (TC10)

skills.name: Powerful Build
skills.effect: May choose skills from the Strength table. The Sorceress may never take this; no more than two warriors in the warband may have it at once. (TC10)

skills.name: Fey Quickness
skills.effect: Avoids melee/missile attacks on a roll of 6; combined with Step Aside or Dodge this improves to 4+ in the relevant area. (TC10)

skills.name: Infiltration
skills.effect: Always placed on the battlefield after the opposing warband, anywhere out of sight and more than 12" from any enemy model. If both sides have infiltrators, lowest D6 sets up first. (RB 93)

skills.name: Master of Poisons
skills.effect: If the Hero doesn't search for rare items, may make D3-1 doses of Dark Venom instead (may be none); must be used next battle, cannot be sold/traded. (TC10)

skills.name: Master of Blades
skills.effect: Parries successfully with a Parry weapon on an equal-or-higher roll (not just higher); with two Parry weapons may parry two attacks instead of one; two Dwarf axes allow re-rolling failed parries. (A02 24)

skills.name: Extra Tough
skills.effect: When rolling on the Heroes Serious Injury chart after being taken out of action, may re-roll once; the second result must be accepted even if worse. (A02 24)

skills.name: Resource Hunter
skills.effect: May modify one Exploration chart dice roll by +1/-1. (A02 24)

skills.name: True Grit
skills.effect: On the Injury table for this Hero: 1-3 is Knocked Down, 4-5 is Stunned, 6 is Out of Action. (A02 24)

skills.name: Thick Skull
skills.effect: 3+ save on a D6 to avoid being Stunned (treated as Knocked Down if saved); 2+ instead of 3+ if also wearing a helmet (replaces the normal Helmet rule). (A02 24)

skills.name: Quiet as a Mouse
skills.effect: Enemy warriors must use half their Initiative value in inches (rounded down) when trying to detect this hidden Halfling.

skills.name: Crude Belch
skills.effect: In the first round of hand-to-hand combat, releases fumes on all enemies in base contact; those failing a Ld test miss their first attack that round.

skills.name: Wizened Halfling
skills.effect: Leaders only. All Halflings within 6" may re-roll failed Leadership tests and use his Leadership for both tests.

skills.name: Stealthy
skills.effect: Halfling Thieves only. May hide even after running, and may run within 8" of enemy models if starting and ending the move hidden.

skills.name: Skilled Huntsman
skills.effect: May fire a ranged weapon and remain hidden: roll D6, on a 3+ stays hidden that turn. Not combinable with black powder weapons.

skills.name: Layers of Fat
skills.effect: Always has a basic saving throw of 6 regardless of the enemy's Strength, on top of any armour worn.

skills.name: Shifty
skills.effect: Gains a bonus attack that strikes first when charged.

skills.name: Infiltration
skills.effect: A warrior with this skill is always placed on the battlefield after the opposing warband and can be placed anywhere on the table as long as it is out of sight of the opposing warband and more than 12" away from any enemy model. If both players have models which infiltrate, roll a D6 for each, and the lowest roll sets up first.

skills.name: Ded Shooty
skills.effect: The clever little git adds +6" to the range of any missile weapons he uses (not including nets).

skills.name: Sneaky Git
skills.effect: The greenskin is so sneaky that he can move D3 of his warband members after all other deployment is complete. Night Goblin Big Boss only.

skills.name: Netter
skills.effect: The goblin is adept at using a net to disable his enemies. They learn their skill hunting wild cave squigs in the depths of the mountains. The technique he has mastered is 'chuck and charge'. The goblin may declare that he is making a net charge. He throws the net at a target in the same way as described in the Mordheim rulebook. If he hits and the target fails to escape the net then target counts as knocked down and the goblin completes his charge. If he misses or the target escapes then the goblin makes a failed charge. If the failed charge would take him into base contact then stop him 1" away. A warrior who is caught in a net will be automatically hit in combat. The goblin must still roll to wound just as with a knocked down enemy. In the warrior's next recovery phase, unless he is stunned or out of action he will cut himself out of the net but cannot do anything else and will go last in combat just as if he had stood up from being knocked down.

skills.name: 'ard ead
skills.effect: 3+ save on a D6 to avoid being Stunned (treated as Knocked Down if saved); 2+ instead of 3+ if also wearing a helmet (replaces the normal Helmet rule). (A02 13)

skills.name: Waaagh!
skills.effect: +D3" to charge range. (A02 13)

skills.name: 'ere we go!
skills.effect: May ignore Fear and Terror tests when charging. (A02 13)

skills.name: da cunnin' plan
skills.effect: Boss only. The warband may re-roll failed Rout tests as long as the Boss is not out of action. (A02 13)

skills.name: well 'ard
skills.effect: +1 to any armour saves. (A02 13)

skills.name: 'eadbasher
skills.effect: Any Knocked Down results this Orc causes in hand-to-hand count as Stunned instead. (A02 13)

skills.name: Bull Rush
skills.effect: When charging, may attempt to knock down the opponent instead of making normal attacks: roll to hit once at +1, no to-wound roll needed — a hit Knocks Down the target. (A02 46)

skills.name: Foul Odor
skills.effect: Living enemies (not Undead/Possessed) are at -1 to hit this warrior in hand-to-hand combat; he cannot carry open flames, and fire attacks against him are resolved at +1 Strength. (A02 13)

skills.name: Taunt
skills.effect: In the shooting phase, instead of shooting/casting, may taunt one visible enemy (nearest, per LOS rules); on a failed Ld test the enemy must move toward the taunter next movement phase. (A02 13)

skills.name: Animal Friendship
skills.effect: Normal animals never attack this warrior; up to two Wardogs he owns do not count against the warband's maximum model count. (A02 13)

skills.name: Blood Oath
skills.effect: Warband leader only. May re-roll a single Rout test once per game. (A02 13)

skills.name: Sea Shanty Singer
skills.effect: The pirate is renowned throughout the seas as one of the greatest singers aboard a ship, able to raise the spirits of any crew with his stirring renditions of ‘The Sloop Johan Bee’, ‘What do you do with a Drunken Halfling?’, and other famous pirate ditties. At the start of his Close Combat phase he can suddenly burst out in song, distracting one opponent in base contact of his choosing. That enemy must pass a Leadership test, or lose 1 Attack that turn. This does not affect Undead or other non-living creatures, such as Possessed.

skills.name: Sea Legs
skills.effect: Even in the strongest seas, the pirate has learned to keep his footing and equilibrium. If he Falls during a battle, he may ignore the effects of the D3 hits on a roll of 4+ (make a single roll to see if any of the hits take effect or not). In addition, if he is knocked down or stunned within 1" of a precipice he may re-roll his Initiative test to see if he falls down or not.

skills.name: Cutlass Master
skills.effect: These short, single bladed swords are the mainstay weapon of any pirate crew, and in the hands of a trained seaman they are superb weapons for close quarters fighting. If the pirate is equipped with a Sword, this skill will give him the additional benefit of also being able to parry successfully if the player rolls equal to the number rolled to hit, not just higher as normal. This extra ability only applies if the Pirate is not in the open; ie., only when in cover or in a building, within 2" of a terrain feature like a wall or tree, etc.

skills.name: Booming Voice
skills.effect: (Captain only) The Captain has spent many a battle bellowing orders to his crew, yelling above the roar of the cannons and the screams of the enemy. Once per turn, the captain may shout encouraging words (or threats) at any one pirate within 8" who just failed his test to see if he runs away from combat, or to stop running away if he was already fleeing. That pirate may then re-roll the test. This can only be done if the Captain is on his feet, but not if the Captain is in close combat himself.

skills.name: Hardy Constitution
skills.effect: Many months at sea, and especially many months eating hardtack, have hardened the pirate’s body to effects that would cause a lesser man to collapse. During the battle, the pirate may ignore any Critical Hits on a roll of 5+ (the wound is treated as normal if the roll is successful). If the roll is failed, the Critical Hit is worked out as normal.

skills.name: Swashbuckler
skills.effect: The pirate cuts a dashing figure in combat, mixing dazzling swordplay and acrobatic feats with charm and witty comments. Even the basest villains in Mordheim respect (and curse) his ability to always seem to effortlessly slip from their grasp. The pirate may make a Leadership Test at the end of any Hand-to-Hand phase (pirate’s or enemy’s turn) if he is still in base contact with any enemy models. If he passes he may make a normal movement away from the enemy (he may not run or charge), without the enemy striking any blows on him. If he fails the test he remains in combat and must fight as normal in the following turn.

skills.name: Ferocious Charge
skills.effect: The Slayer may double his attacks on the turn in which he charges. He will suffer a –1 to hit penalty on that turn.

skills.name: Monster Slayer
skills.effect: The Slayer always wounds any opponent on a roll of 4+, regardless of Toughness, unless his own strength (with weapon modifiers) would mean that a lower roll than this is needed.

skills.name: Berserker
skills.effect: The Slayer may add +1 to his to hit rolls during the turn in which he charges.

skills.name: Bulging Biceps
skills.effect: The Pit Fighter may ignore the entire ‘heavy’ weapons special rule penalty. The Strength bonus will now apply to all rounds in Close-Combat. So a Morning Star will give +1 Strength in all turns not only the first one.

skills.name: Force of Will
skills.effect: When the Pit Fighter loses his last wound and is taken Out-of-Action, he must roll a D6 equal to or under his Toughness. Each following round he has to roll again on his toughness but then with a -1 modifier for each subsequent round. If he succeeds he gets up and may continue to fight. When he gets taken Out-of-Action a second time he’ll be removed as normal.

skills.name: Arms Master
skills.effect: The Pit Fighter may now ignore all ‘difficult to use’ rules for all weapons. This enables him to combine certain types of weapons. He can combine a Morning Star with a buckler, or even a Morning Star with a Morning Star.

skills.name: Body Slam
skills.effect: Instead of making a normal charge, the Pit Fighter may attempt to slam his opponent to the ground, he burrows his shoulder deep into his opponent’s stomach. Instead of making his normal attacks the Pit Fighter may make a single attack resolved as following: +1 Str, +1 to Hit, no weapon bonuses or abilities. Critical hit on a 5+.

skills.name: Grizzled Veteran
skills.effect: The Pit Fighter is used to fighting fearsome monsters and being cornered in the pit when there’s no escape. He has been close to death so many times that he has made his peace and the thought of death no longer bothers him. The Pit Fighter is immune to all psychology.

skills.name: Sign of Sigmar
skills.effect: Possessed or Undead opponents lose their first attack against her in the first round of hand-to-hand combat (minimum 1 attack retained). (RB 83)

skills.name: Protection of Sigmar
skills.effect: Any spell targeting her is nullified on a D6 roll of 4+ (and does not affect any other models either if nullified). (RB 83)

skills.name: Utter Determination
skills.effect: Matriarch only. May re-roll any failed Rout tests. (RB 83)

skills.name: Righteous Fury
skills.effect: Hates all Skaven, Undead or Possessed warbands and models. Suggested Changes: may extend to other 'evil'/'neutral' warbands case-by-case. (RB 83)

skills.name: Absolute Faith
skills.effect: May re-roll any Fear tests and need not test when fighting alone against several opponents. (RB 83)

skills.name: Infiltration
skills.effect: A warrior with this skill is always placed on the battlefield after the opposing warband and can be placed anywhere on the table as long as it is out of sight of the opposing warband and more than 12" away from any enemy model. If both players have models which infiltrate, roll a D6 for each, and the lowest roll sets up first.

skills.name: See in Shadows
skills.effect: The warrior’s senses have become especially keen from years spent walking the shadows. As long as he has movement to reach them, the warrior may always roll to charge opponents he cannot see (instead of the normal 4").

skills.name: Hide in Shadows
skills.effect: Over time Shadow Warriors have learned how to freeze in place and remain undetected, even from the heightened senses of their Dark Elf cousins. An enemy warrior attempting to detect this warrior when he is Hidden must halve his Initiative before measuring the distance.

skills.name: Sniper
skills.effect: Long years of guerrilla warfare against the Dark Elves have taught Shadow Warriors how to strike from the shadows without being seen. If Hidden, a warrior with this skill may shoot or cast spells and still remain Hidden. If his target is not immediately taken out of action by the Sniper they get to test against their Initiative in an attempt to spot him. A successful test means that the Sniper has been spotted and is no longer hidden.

skills.name: Powerful Build
skills.effect: The warrior is strongly built for an Elf, and is capable of feats of strength not often seen among the people of Ulthuan. A warrior with this skill may choose skills from the Strength skills table from now on. This skill may not be taken by Shadow Weavers. There may never be more than two Elves with this skill in the warband at any one time.

skills.name: Master of Runes
skills.effect: The Shadow Weaver has learned to harness the power of the High Elven runes of power (see Elven Runestones, below) to a degree few mages attain. When using Elven Runestones, the mage is +1 to his dispel roll. In addition, the mage can inscribe the weapons and armour of one of his fellow warriors with Elven runes. One member of the Warband may reroll a single failed armour save or Parry roll once per battle. After a single battle, the runes lose their glamour and must be redone. This skill may only be taken by Shadow Weavers.

skills.name: Black Hunger
skills.effect: Declared at the start of the Skaven's turn: +1 Attack and +D3" move for that turn, but suffers D3 S3 hits with no armour save at the end of the turn. (RB 93)

skills.name: Tail Fighting
skills.effect: May wield a shield, knife, or sword with its tail, gaining an extra attack with that weapon or a +1 armour save bonus. (RB 93)

skills.name: Wall Runner
skills.effect: No Initiative test needed to climb walls/sheer surfaces. Suggested Changes: may run/charge up walls, always striking last when doing so. (RB 93)

skills.name: Infiltration
skills.effect: Always placed on the battlefield after the opposing warband, anywhere out of sight and more than 12" from any enemy model. If both sides have infiltrators, lowest D6 sets up first. (RB 93)

skills.name: Art of Silent Death
skills.effect: Fights bare-pawed without penalty, counting as two weapons (+1 attack); causes a critical hit on a to-wound roll of 5-6 instead of just 6. Stacks with Eshin Fighting Claws (+2 Attacks instead of +1). (RB 93)

skills.name: Ferocious Charge
skills.effect: May double Attacks on the turn he charges, at -1 to hit that turn. (TC14)

skills.name: Monster Slayer
skills.effect: Always wounds on a 4+ regardless of Toughness, unless his own (modified) Strength would need a lower roll. (TC14)

skills.name: Berserker
skills.effect: +1 to close combat to-hit rolls on the turn he charges; not usable with Ferocious Charge. (TC14)

skills.name: Transfixing Glare
skills.effect: Usable on a living, non-Immune-to-Psychology model in base contact at the start of the combat phase; victim must pass a Ld test on 2D6 or be transfixed (cannot attack, treated as Knocked Down when attacked). (TC11)

skills.name: Mist Form
skills.effect: Recovery-phase transformation: 2D6" move, cannot attack/shoot/cast or benefit from armour; hit/wound rolls against the Vampire need a natural 6 (unmodifiable); injury rolls reduced by -2. Knocked Down reverts him to physical form immediately; may change back voluntarily in a later recovery phase. (TC11)

skills.name: Ratswarm Form
skills.effect: Recovery-phase transformation (even while Knocked Down/Stunned, with normal stand-up penalties) to a rat-swarm profile (M6 WS3 BS0 S3 T3 W* I* A4 Ld*, * = as Vampire); no weapons/armour, cannot shoot/cast, fights unarmed without penalty, can pass through small gaps/holes. (TC11)

skills.name: Bat Form
skills.effect: As Ratswarm Form's transformation rules, using profile M8 WS3 BS0 S3 T2 W* I* A1 Ld* (* = as Vampire); flies, ignores movement penalties, doubles move when running/charging (cannot 'run' as such); no weapons/armour, cannot shoot/cast, fights unarmed without penalty. (TC11)

skills.name: Giant Wolf Form
skills.effect: As Ratswarm/Bat Form's transformation rules, using profile M9 WS4 BS0 S4 T3 W* I* A2 Ld* (* = as Vampire); no weapons/armour, cannot shoot/cast, fights unarmed without penalty. (TC11)

skills.name: Proven Warrior
skills.effect: May only be taken by a Young'un with the Black Orc Blood ability and 25 experience. Once he gains this skill the model is considered a full Black Orc Warrior, though he keeps the title of Young'un. He follows all the rules for Black Orcs, uses their equipment list, and has access to the same skill lists as a Black Orc.

skills.name: 'ard Ead
skills.effect: The warrior has a thick skull even for an Orc. He has a special 3+ save on a D6 to avoid being stunned; if the save is made, treat a stunned result as knocked down instead. If he also wears a helmet the save is 2+ instead, taking the place of the normal helmet special rule.

skills.name: Waaagh!
skills.effect: The warrior may add +D3" to his charge range.

skills.name: 'ere We Go!
skills.effect: The model may ignore fear tests when charging.

skills.name: Da Cunnin' Plan
skills.effect: Only the Boss may have this skill. The warband may re-roll any failed Rout tests as long as the Boss is not out of action.

skills.name: 'eadbasher
skills.effect: Any knocked down results the Orc causes in hand-to-hand count as stunned results instead.

skills.name: Skink Hunter
skills.effect: An Amazon with this skill always strikes first in the first round of combat against Skink models, no matter who charged.

skills.name: Elixir of Life
skills.effect: Any Amazon with this Elixir may re-roll a Serious Injury roll once after the battle, accepting the result of the second roll.

skills.name: Mesmerising Dance
skills.effect: Any model fighting in base contact with the Amazon must take a Leadership test at the start of each turn. If they fail they cannot attack that turn, but may defend themselves. The dance is useless against Lizardmen and Undead, who are immune to their charms.

skills.name: Savage Fury
skills.effect: The Amazon receives +1 Attack when charging and is immune to charm effects and fear.

skills.name: Concealment
skills.effect: When hiding in jungle terrain, all enemy models must halve the range at which they can spot her.

skills.name: Infiltration
skills.effect: The Hero may set up anywhere on the table but no closer than 12" to an enemy, and must start the game hiding.

skills.name: Great Hunter
skills.effect: The Skink is adept at making the most of available cover and imposes an additional -1 to hit him while he is in cover, i.e. a -2 to hit penalty.

skills.name: Bellowing Battle Roar
skills.effect: The Saurus' roar is so deafening that enemy models in base contact suffer -1 to hit in the first round of combat against him.

skills.name: Toughened Hide
skills.effect: Through years of battle the Saurus' hide has hardened, and he will only be taken out of action on a 6+.

battleMonk.name: Battle Monks Special Skills (Border Town Burning)

skills.name: Energy Focus
skills.effect: If fighting unarmed, the Hero may reduce his Attacks by -1 to gain +1 Strength in close combat. He may sacrifice any number of attacks this way.

skills.name: Lightning Speed
skills.effect: The monk may triple his Movement when running or charging, and may run even when there are enemy models within 8".

skills.name: Leap of Faith
skills.effect: The Hero cannot be intercepted while charging. He may escape from combat by leaping away without having to pass a Leadership test, and may declare a leaping charge in the same turn.

skills.name: Human Shield
skills.effect: If two or more models are engaged in close combat with the monk, he may grab one to use as a shield instead of making his normal attacks. He must pass an Initiative test after the first model has attacked but before the second does. On a success he grabs the first model and the second directs its full attacks at that friendly model; after the combat phase the model breaks free. On a failure both the monk and the second model use their normal attacks.

skills.name: Warmonger
skills.effect: Emissary only. The Emissary may make a Leadership test before the battle. If it succeeds, D3+1 Raging Peasants join the warband for the next game, which may exceed the maximum number of warriors. Each Raging Peasant is subject to Hatred for the duration of that battle.

skills.name: Sand Worm
skills.effect: The warrior can bury himself in sand and become almost undetectable. The model can hide in open ground. Cannot be used inside buildings.

skills.name: Hit and Run
skills.effect: The warrior can run and shoot but suffer -2 to hit instead of the -1 to hit for moving.

skills.name: Weather Tolerant
skills.effect: The warrior has grown so used to the weather it doesn't even affect him anymore. Weather conditions such as heat and such no longer affect this model.

skills.name: Extra Tough
skills.effect: This Dwarf is notorious for walking away from wounds that would kill a lesser being. When rolling on the Heroes Serious Injury chart for this Hero after a game in which he has been taken out of action, the dice may be re-rolled once. The result of this second dice roll must be accepted, even if it is a worse result.

skills.name: Resource Hunter
skills.effect: This Dwarf is especially good at locating valuable resources. When rolling on the Exploration chart at the end of a game, the Hero may modify one dice roll by +1/-1.

skills.name: True Grit
skills.effect: Dwarfs are hardy individuals and this Hero is hardy even for a Dwarf! When rolling on the Injury table for this Hero, a roll of 1-3 is treated as knocked down, 4-5 as stunned, and 6 as out of action.

skills.name: Thick Skull
skills.effect: The Hero has a thick skull, even for a Dwarf. He has a 3+ save on a D6 to avoid being stunned. If the save is made, treat a stunned result as knocked down instead. If the Dwarf also wears a helmet, this save is 2+ instead of 3+ (this takes the place of the normal Helmet special rule).

skills.name: chaos engineer
skills.effect: The Hero has great technical skill and can use this to craft wicked armours and weapons. Whenever a Hero with this skill searches for Chaos armour (including Mechanical Suits) or Obsidian Weapons, he gets +3 on the roll. This represents the Engineer’s ability to craft these items himself. The Hero ignores the Rarity and Gift of Chaos special rules and may never wear the Chaos Armours.

skills.name: tyrant
skills.effect: This skill is for the Chaos Dwarf leader only. This Priest of Hashut is renowned for his tyranny. His word is absolute so his own warband fears his cruelty more than the enemy. When making a Rout test, and if led by a leader with this skill, the leader may inspire his warband to stick around. This skill allows the leader to re-roll any failed Rout test, as long as the leader is not knocked down or stunned. If re-rolled, the new result will apply even if the new result is worse. If the leader is taken out of action the warband must make an immediate Rout test.

skills.name: Virtue of Purity
skills.effect: The Knight's sole purpose is to serve the Lady of the Lake. His purity of heart and discipline endow him with the strength of spirit to resist enemy magic. Any spell cast against the knight will be dispelled on the D6 roll of a 4+. This is a natural dispel on account of the knight's extreme piety.

skills.name: Virtue of Valour
skills.effect: The Knight has vowed to confront the biggest and strongest foes. The more awesome his enemy, the more valourous are his efforts. If fighting a model with a higher Strength characteristic than himself, the Knight may re-roll any failed to hit rolls in hand-to-hand combat.

skills.name: Virtue of Discipline
skills.effect: The Knight has total faith in his chivalric code: he maintains self-control in the face of adversity, and displays complete confidence whatever the odds. Once per game, if the knight is not out of action, stunned or knocked down, you may re-roll a failed rout test.

skills.name: Virtue of Noble Disdain
skills.effect: The Knight has nothing but contempt for enemies who hide behind weapons of dishonour. The Knight is subject to hatred of all enemies armed with shooting weapons.

skills.name: Virtue of Impetuous
skills.effect: The Knight is eager to get to grips with the enemy. He charges into combat with reckless enthusiasm. The Knight may add +D3" to his move when charging. Roll the dice each time you wish to charge and before moving the model.

skills.name: Renowned Virtue
skills.effect: The Knight may learn one Virtue from the original Bretonnian Warband list, written by Tom Merrigan. The “Renowned Virtue” skill may only be taken once.

skills.name: Questing Vow
skills.effect: Questing Knight only. If the knight is charging, charged by, or in combat with a fear-causing enemy, they may reroll any Leadership test they take once, accepting the second result. This includes Rout tests.

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.effect: Each turn, the Knight may make an additional attack with a shield or kite shield, which is made at –1 Strength. Treat the shield attack as a club.

skills.name: Bulging Muscles
skills.effect: The Knight retains the +1/+2 Strength bonus from Flails and Morning Stars after the first round of combat.

skills.name: Untiring
skills.effect: The Knight ignores movement penalties for wearing armour while on foot. In addition, strength, axes, critical hits, and similar modifiers cannot reduce the saving throw lower than 5+, nor will it be ignored by any non-magical means.

skills.name: Infiltration
skills.effect: A warrior with this skill is always placed on the battlefield after the opposing warband and can be placed anywhere on the table as long as it is out of sight of the opposing warband and more than 12" away from any enemy model. If both players have models which infiltrate, roll a D6 for each, and the lowest roll sets up first.

skills.name: Fury of Khaine
skills.effect: The Dark Elf is infused with an intense raging thirst for blood and is a whirlwind in hand-to-hand combat, moving from opponent to opponent. The Dark Elf may make a 4" follow up move if he takes all of his opponents Out Of Action. If he comes into contact with another enemy this starts a new combat. This new combat takes place in the following turn and the model counts as charging. May not follow up in the opponent’s turn.

skills.name: Fey Quickness
skills.effect: Few can ever hope to match an Elf’s inhuman quickness and agility. An Elf with Fey Quickness can avoid melee or missile attacks on a roll of 6. If the Elf also has Step Aside or Dodge this will increase to a 4+ in the relevant area. For example, an Elf with Fey Quickness and Step Aside avoids melee attacks on a 4+ and missile attacks on a 6.

skills.name: Master of Poisons
skills.effect: The Dark Elf is proficient in concocting different poisons. If the Hero doesn’t search for rare items, he may make D3–1 doses of Dark Venom instead. There is a chance of getting none, as the hero doesn’t have access to a stable workplace. The poison must be used in the next battle and cannot be sold or traded to other warbands as the Dark Elves guard their secrets very carefully.

skills.name: Powerful Build
skills.effect: The warrior is strongly built for an Elf, and is capable of feats of strength not often seen among the people of Ulthuan. A warrior with this skill may choose skills from the Strength skills table from now on. This skill may not be taken by Shadow Weavers. There may never be more than two Elves with this skill in the warband at any one time.

skills.name: Extra Tough
skills.effect: This Dwarf is notorious for walking away from wounds that would kill a lesser being. When rolling on the Heroes Serious Injury chart for this Hero after a game in which he has been taken out of action, the dice may be re-rolled once. The result of this second dice roll must be accepted, even if it is a worse result.

skills.name: Resource Hunter
skills.effect: This Dwarf is especially good at locating valuable resources. When rolling on the Exploration chart at the end of a game, the Hero may modify one dice roll by +1/-1.

skills.name: True Grit
skills.effect: Dwarfs are hardy individuals and this Hero is hardy even for a Dwarf! When rolling on the Injury table for this Hero, a roll of 1-3 is treated as knocked down, 4-5 as stunned, and 6 as out of action.

skills.name: Thick Skull
skills.effect: The Hero has a thick skull, even for a Dwarf. He has a 3+ save on a D6 to avoid being stunned. If the save is made, treat a stunned result as knocked down instead. If the Dwarf also wears a helmet, this save is 2+ instead of 3+ (this takes the place of the normal Helmet special rule).

skills.name: Combat Master
skills.effect: This Dwarf’s martial skills surpass those of a normal warrior; he is used to fighting by himself against hordes of opponents and coming through unscathed. When using a weapon that has a Parry special rule, this hero parries successfully if he beats or matches his opponent’s highest ‘to hit’ roll, not just if he beats the roll. In addition, if this warrior is using two weapons that have the Parry special rule, he is allowed to parry two attacks (if his two dice match or beat the highest two attack dice against him) instead of the normal maximum of one.

skills.name: Ferocious Charge
skills.effect: The Slayer may double his attacks on the turn in which he charges. He will suffer a –1 to hit penalty on that turn.

skills.name: Monster Slayer
skills.effect: The Slayer always wounds any opponent on a roll of 4+, regardless of Toughness, unless his own strength (with weapon modifiers) would mean that a lower roll than this is needed.

skills.name: Berserker
skills.effect: The Slayer may add +1 to his to hit rolls during the turn in which he charges.

skills.name: Remove Animosity
skills.effect: A Forest Goblin Brave may choose to remove his Animosity instead of choosing a skill, should they earn one.

skills.name: banditry
skills.effect: Between missions, the bandit goes off and robs travelers or other innocent victims. Instead of searching for Rare equipment, the hero may engage in banditry - roll a D6, on a result of 2–6, the banditry is successful and the hero adds D6+1 gold to the warband's stash. However, on a result of 1, the attempted robbery has somehow gone wrong - roll on the Serious Injury table for the bandit, as if he had been taken Out of Action in the last game. If several heroes have this skill, it is quite possible that some are successful and some not in their Banditry attempt between games...that is the nature of thieves' honor - if a man falls behind, he is usually on his own! This skill may not be combined with the Huckster's Slick Operator special ability.

skills.name: hide in shadows
skills.effect: The Bandit has become an expert at concealing himself from his enemies (and potential victims!). An enemy warrior attempting to detect this warrior when he is Hidden must halve his Initiative (round up) before measuring the distance.

skills.name: jump back
skills.effect: This warrior is an expert at getting himself out of sticky situations. If the warrior is in close combat with an enemy warrior (and not Knocked Down or Stunned) at the start of his Movement Phase, he may attempt to jump out of combat. To attempt to do so, the warrior must make an Initiative test. If he fails the test, the warrior will automatically strike last in that round of combat. However, if he passes, immediately move him 1" away from the enemy warrior (this does not count against his movement for that Movement Phase); he may then move and otherwise act normally for the rest of that turn (even charging back into combat if he chooses!).

skills.name: sniper
skills.effect: The bandit is an expert at shooting his victims from the comfort of cover. When Hiding, the warrior may cast spells or shoot and still remain Hidden. Note that the bandit may not use this skill if he is shooting a Blackpowder weapon!

skills.name: throw voice
skills.effect: This rogue has mastered the art of misdirecting enemies who get too close by making them hear noises or voices some distance from his location. If an enemy warrior is attempting to detect the bandit while he is Hidden, roll a D6 - on a result of 4 or better, the bandit is undetected and remains Hidden.

skills.name: Animal friendship
skills.effect: Having grown up amidst the animals of the forest, this warrior exudes a certain charm to all ‘normal’ animals (ie, warhorses, warhounds, etc). Animals will never attack him and up to two wardogs that the warrior owns do not count against the maximum number of models in the warband.

skills.name: Infiltration
skills.effect: A warrior with this skill is always placed on the battlefield after the opposing warband and can be placed anywhere on the table as long as it is out of sight of the opposing warband and more than 12" away from any enemy model. If both players have models which infiltrate, roll a D6 for each, and the lowest roll sets up first.

skills.name: master trapper
skills.effect: This huntsman is a masterful trap setter. Trip wire range has been extended by this warrior to reach 4". Traps set by a master trapper are triggered by a score of 2+.

skills.name: foul odour
skills.effect: Worshippers of Taal are one and all prodigious drinkers and none too hygienic! This warrior rises head and shoulders above the rest. After a lifetime of drinking, liquor has little effect on him any more... not that this stops him from consuming massive quantities! His unwashed clothes and sweat reek of alcohol and all living enemies (not Undead or Possessed) are at –1 to hit him in close combat. In addition, the warrior cannot carry any open flames (torch, lantern, etc.) and fire attacks made against him are resolved at +1 Strength as his beer soaked clothing burns readily.

skills.name: pathfinder
skills.effect: Taal has gifted this hunter with an uncanny ability to find paths through unexplored territories. Roll one additional D6 during the exploration phase. A warband may only contain one pathfinder.

skills.name: hide in shadows
skills.effect: The warrior has learned to crouch unseen in any cover they can find. Enemy models must halve their Initiative when attempting to find this warrior when he is Hidden.

skills.name: chosen of chaos
skills.effect: The Hero has been found worthy of his god’s service and entered the rank of a Chaos Warrior. He uses the maximum profile for Warriors of Chaos and the Hero equipment list (if he does not already).

skills.name: tattooed body
skills.effect: Only the warband's leader may have this skill. The Hero's body is covered with unholy Chaos signs to attract his patron's attention. The Eye of the Gods special rule's effect (of becoming a Chaos Spawn or receiving a Mark) happens on a result of 10+ instead of 12+ only. Note that for the less favoured Norse leaders this is 11+.

skills.name: sweeping blow
skills.effect: Whenever the Hero takes an enemy model out of action using a double-handed weapon he may immediately make an additional attack against another model in base contact. Requires the Strongman skill.

skills.name: mutant
skills.effect: The Hero may buy one mutation. See the Mutations section of the Possessed on special rules. Heroes with the Mark of Onogal may choose a Blessing of Nurgle instead except the Mark of Nurgle. Note that unlike other skills Marauder Heroes may take this skill more than once.

skills.name: heart of the warrior
skills.effect: Only the warband’s leader may have this skill. He may re-roll any failed Rout test and is immune to fear and All Alone tests.

skills.name: Bribery
skills.effect: Whenever the warband has to take a Rout test, the Merchant may talk his hirelings into staying a little longer and face the danger. He may immediately pay 5 gc per non-Hero warband member (including Hired Swords!) still in the game. If he does, one member taken out of action already does not count for Rout tests. If after that, a Rout test is still required, test as normal. This skill may be used as many times as required so long as the coffers aren’t empty!

skills.name: Dubious Income
skills.effect: The Merchant has set up an underground business that proves to be quite profitable. After every battle in which the Merchant was not taken out of action, he may choose to use this skill before the trading phase (i.e. before any gold is spent). If he does, he must pass a Ld test. If the test is successful, the warband receives one gold coin per Experience point the Merchant has. If the test is failed, the warband loses up to the same amount of gold coins.

skills.name: Wholesale
skills.effect: The Merchant is known for buying items in greater numbers and so is especially welcome at the other merchants. He may search for D3+1 rare items after each battle instead of one item only (if he was not taken out of action, of course!).

skills.name: Deal Breaker
skills.effect: When trying to sell items through the Trade special rule, the Merchant gets a +1 bonus on the roll to see what the item would fetch.

skills.name: Connected
skills.effect: The Merchant knows many retailers and ways of getting hold of rare items. Instead of searching for rare items as normal, he may visit the local black market and its fencers. If he does, he may search for items from the following table, applying the normal rules.

skills.name: barbarian courage
skills.effect: As Norse warriors strive to die bravely in battle, they learn to fear nothing and embrace hardship. This hero never needs to take All Alone tests and may re-roll failed fear tests.

skills.name: battle tongue
skills.effect: Only a hero with the leader skill may gain this skill. It allows models within 12" of him to use his leadership, rather than the normal 6".

skills.name: berserk charge
skills.effect: The Norse are very skilled with weapons that many other races see as primitive and savage. When this hero is armed with an axe or double handed weapon, he may re-roll all failed to hit rolls when he charges.

skills.name: crushing blow
skills.effect: Norse warriors train in almost all of their spare time. They are expert fighters and learn to put all of their strength into very powerful attacks. No enemy may parry an attack made by this hero because it strikes with such great power that it pushes right through a buckler or sword.

skills.name: shield master
skills.effect: Norse warriors begin training with shields when they are still children. Some warriors become so skilled with these weapons they can block almost any blow against them. When this hero is armed with a shield he may parry with it in addition to getting a 6+ save.

skavenOfClanPestilens.name: Skaven of Clan Pestilens Special Skills

skills.name: black hunger
skills.effect: The Skaven can draw upon the dreaded Black Hunger, the fighting frenzy which gives him unnatural strength and speed but can ravage him from inside. The Skaven Hero may declare at the beginning of his turn that he is using this skill. The Hero may add +1 attack and +D3" to the total move to his profile for the duration of his own turn but will suffer D3 S3 hits with no armour save possible at the end of the turn.

skills.name: censer bearer
skills.effect: Only a Clan Pestilens member with the Black Hunger special skill may choose the Censer Bearer special skill. A Clan Pestilens member with this skill is called Censer Bearer. He gains the special rule frenzy and the only weapon he may use in close combat is a censer.

skills.name: rotten body
skills.effect: A Clan Pestilens member with this skill has grown accustomed to poisons, diseases and the fog of death emanated by censers. He is now immune to poison and diseases and, if taken out of action because of a failed test by wielding a censer, he will not have to roll for injuries at the end of the battle, recovering automatically.

skills.name: contagious
skills.effect: Only a Clan Pestilens member with the Rotten Body special skill may choose the Contagious special skill. A model who inflicts an injury in close combat that sends the contagious member of the Clan Pestilens out of action must take a Toughness test. Roll a D6. If the result is higher than the Toughness of the model taking the test, he will suffer an automatic wound. A result of 6 always inflicts a wound. Models of undead and possessed never take this test.

skills.name: ignore pain
skills.effect: Only a Clan Pestilens member with the Resilient strength skill may choose the Ignore Pain special skill. A Clan Pestilens member with this skill treats "Stunned" injuries as "Knocked Down".

skills.name: corpse bomb
skills.effect: Special magics and rituals can cause a Zombie to explode when they are near the enemy. Secretly nominate one Zombie at the beginning of the battle to be a Corpse Bomb. If the enemy charges or is charged by the Zombie, it immediately detonates. All models within D6 inches take D3 Strength 4 hits. The detonated Zombie may never be used again as it is splattered in a million pieces! Corpse bombs killed by shooting do not detonate. Only one Zombie at a time can be a corpse bomb although the skill can be taken by both the Necromancer and the Liche.

skills.name: deathspeaker
skills.effect: At the start of the battle, the undead player may deploy D3 Zombies for free. These zombies do not count towards the maximum number of models in the warband, but increase the warband’s rating as normal. Zombies created in this way may not be used as Corpse Bombs. These Zombies only last for the duration of the battle.

skills.name: wraith touch
skills.effect: The hero may make a Wraith Touch attack instead of their normal attacks in close combat. The hero making a Wraith Touch makes a single unarmed attack, if it hits, it wounds automatically, all rules that apply to unarmed attacks apply to the Wraith Touch. If a Liche uses this skill and wounds, then he may regain one lost wound. This may not take the hero beyond his starting total. Necromancers do not regain wounds with this skill. This skill has no effect on the Possessed or Undead.

skills.name: forbidden rite
skills.effect: If the hero with this skill did not search for rare items during their last exploration phase, then they start the next battle with a pool of D3+1 (+1) modifiers they can use to increase their casting rolls. They may use as many of these modifiers at a time as they desire.

skills.name: summoner
skills.effect: The maximum warband size is increased by 1.

theSonsOfHashut.name: The Sons of Hashut Special Skills

skills.name: Extra Tough
skills.effect: This Dwarf is notorious for walking away from wounds that would kill a lesser being. When rolling on the Heroes Serious Injury chart for this Hero after a game in which he has been taken out of action, the dice may be re-rolled once. The result of this second dice roll must be accepted, even if it is a worse result.

skills.name: True Grit
skills.effect: Dwarfs are hardy individuals and this Hero is hardy even for a Dwarf! When rolling on the Injury table for this Hero, a roll of 1-3 is treated as knocked down, 4-5 as stunned, and 6 as out of action.

skills.name: Thick Skull
skills.effect: The Hero has a thick skull, even for a Dwarf. He has a 3+ save on a D6 to avoid being stunned. If the save is made, treat a stunned result as knocked down instead. If the Dwarf also wears a helmet, this save is 2+ instead of 3+ (this takes the place of the normal Helmet special rule).

skills.name: Unlimited hatred
skills.effect: The warrior suffers hatred against everyone.
